delete.description:
Deletes the assets of the space that match the given filters. All filters must match for an asset to be deleted (AND combination).
To match one of multiple values for the same field, provide an array as the filter value.
Depending on the mode, the matching assets are either moved to the trash bin (TRASHBIN, default) or permanently deleted (PERMANENT).
Folders are never deleted by this endpoint and assets that are already in the trash bin are ignored. Stacks are deleted as a whole, including all of their versions.
At most `limit` assets are deleted per call. Matching more than that is not an error - `total` reports how many assets match in total, so the caller can repeat the call until `total` is 0.
When deleting in batches, keep requesting page 0: deleting a page shifts the remaining matches, so incrementing the page would skip assets.
If the user is not allowed to delete one of the matching assets, the call fails. Moving to the trash bin is atomic, a permanent deletion commits in batches, so assets removed by an earlier batch stay deleted.
